items.label: Nightstand with Various RGB Color LED Lights
items.value: Our nightstands come with smart LED light. The LED nightstand's light color, brightness and strobe mode can be adjusted at will according to the needs of the scene. The soft and colorful lighting design of the night stand brings a warm and stylish dreamy atmosphere to your bedroom

items.label: Nightstand with Charging Station
items.value: In order to meet more charging needs, this nightstand with charging station adopts the latest plug-in design. Our end tables set of 2 has 2 outlets and 1 USB port and 1 type-c port which can totally charge your lamps, phones, tablet at the same time

items.label: Night Stands with Large Storage
items.value: The 4 tier night stands with 2 fabric drawers provide storage space for you. Top panel and open shelf can hold common items and equipment such as decorations, books, game consoles, etc. 2 fabric drawers with handles can hold personal items and less frequently used items to help you organize your belongings

items.label: Individuality and Stability
items.value: Our bedside table are made of particle board and carbon metal. The small side table is easy to clean and maintain. The fabric drawer design of the nightstand not only provides you with perfect storage space, but also greatly reduces the weight of the nightstand. The top and middle shelf of the side table are crafted from FSC-certified wood panels

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: Simple structure, numbered parts, installation manual and tools allow you to finish the end tables in 30 minutes. If the product comes with missing parts or damaged parts, please feel free to contact us and we will arrange new parts replacement
